title: Propagation of Chaos for Mean-field Mean Reflected Backward Stochastic Differential Equations
summary: In this paper, we establish a propagation of chaos result for mean-field mean reflected backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs), where both the generator and constraint depend on the distribution of the solution. When the generator does not rely on $z$, under mild Lipschitz and integrability conditions, we prove existence and uniqueness of the solution to the interacting particle system for general reflections.
